_comentario: Receta de ejemplo del estilo Flow con Nimbo (SaaS B2B ficticio). Sustituye marca_id, producto_id y actor por los tuyos (motor brand list · motor product list · motor actor list). Los textos *_en van en inglés porque son prompts; los segmentos, en el idioma del anuncio. Las pantallas reales de la app NO las pinta la IA: el montaje del motor las compone desde las capturas del producto.
audiencia: responsables comerciales de pymes de servicios que pierden leads por contestar tarde
producto_en: the Nimbo web app, a blue and white sales dashboard, open on a silver laptop and on her phone; screens are seen at an angle and softly out of focus, never with readable text
ubicacion_en: a small, real home office: a white desk with a silver laptop, a phone, a notebook, a mug and a plant, a shelf with folders behind, white walls
luz_en: soft natural daylight from a window on the left
pelo_en: shoulder-length straight dark brown hair tucked behind one ear, natural and slightly imperfect

segmentos.texto: ¿Cuánto tardas en contestar a un lead nuevo?
Cada minuto que esperas, ese lead se enfría.
Mira: entra el formulario y Nimbo le escribe al momento.
Le manda el enlace para reservar y avisa al comercial.
Pruébalo catorce días gratis. Te lo dejo aquí abajo.

fotograma_clave.escena_en: Vertical 9:16 smartphone selfie photo taken by the woman herself with the phone's front camera at arm's length: she sits at her desk in front of the open laptop, turned towards the camera with a slightly raised eyebrow and a half smile, mouth slightly open mid-sentence, looking into the lens; the laptop screen is visible beside her, at an angle and out of focus

planos.accion_en: she sits at her desk filming a selfie, turns to the lens with a raised eyebrow
medium shot from the side: she glances at the laptop and taps the desk impatiently with two fingers
close-up: she picks up her phone from the desk and turns it towards the camera as a new notification lights up the screen, out of focus

b.continuidad_en: Her hair is still tucked behind one ear and the same mug and plant stay on the desk.

planos.accion_en: over-the-shoulder shot: she scrolls slowly on the laptop trackpad, the screen softly out of focus, and nods
back to the selfie at the desk: she smiles and points down towards the bottom of the frame

escritorio.prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 photo of the white desk from a 45-degree angle: the silver laptop open with its screen turned slightly away from the camera, a phone face up beside it, a mug and a plant; nobody in the frame. Clean space in the upper third.

movimientos.escritorio: Vertical footage, very slow, smooth push-in towards the laptop on the white desk; soft daylight shifts gently. Nothing else moves. No people, no text, no logos, no music.
